notes: POC summary: started with hosted API to validate product UX. Primary flows: conversational product assistant (supporting feature discovery), doc search across product docs, and automated meeting summaries for PMs.

Usage profile observed during hosted trial: lots of short chat prompts + long generated summaries (response tokens >> prompt tokens). Embeddings used for semantic doc search; embedding volume spiked during nightly re-index jobs.
Quote from PM: 'Latency under 350ms for short chat responses is ideal; summaries can be ~1s acceptable.'
Cost sensitivity: product team cares about per-user unit economics; CFO flagged embedding costs and background batch re-index as largest cost risk.
Technical ask: want Dedicated plan that supports VPC peering into AWS (us-east) and EU residency mirror for EU customers. Need KMS integration and audit logs retention options (90/365 days).
Security: SSO via SAML (Okta), SOC2 attestation required before procurement. Legal asked if we can contractually limit data residency to eu-west-1 for EU customers.
Routing/fallback: need policy to route low-latency requests to hosted low-latency pool and fall back to cheaper quantized model for bulk summarization during peak.

Current model preferences: open model family (LLama variants) for price control, but they want Redwood-verified performance profiles. Interested in quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce GPU costs.

POC metrics (hosted): average daily active users 4.2k in trial cohort, avg messages/day per DAU 3.6, peak concurrent chats observed ~120 across all regions, sustained QPS ~6, peak QPS ~18 during morning batch window.

Token mix observed in POC: avg prompt tokens 210, avg response tokens 780 (skewed by meeting-summary flows). Embedding API calls: 45k vectors/day during index ramp; nightly reindex runs 5-6x cost of steady-state.

SE notes from Diego: recommend Dedicated baseline for 2x peak sustained QPS headroom, prioritized autoscale policies for nightly batch windows. Suggested GPU profile: 2x A10G-like nodes for chat + 1x cheaper T4-like node for quantized bulk summarization and embeddings.
Next deliverable requested: a Dedicated sizing workbook that converts QPS + token mix into concurrent KV cache sizing, expected GPU hours, and estimated monthly cost under reserved vs burst billing.
Open ask: legal needs sample DPA + data processing addendum; infra team asked for network throughput numbers and VPC egress diagram.
dedicated_sizing_summary: POC-derived targets: sustained QPS 6, peak QPS 18, expected concurrency 40-130 depending on time of day
Token mix used for sizing: avg prompt 210 tokens, avg completion 780 tokens, embeddings 1536-d vectors; nightly index increases embedding QPS by 4-6x
Suggested Dedicated baseline: 2 inference pools (chat pool: 2x A10G-style nodes w/ 40 concurrent sessions each; bulk pool: 1x T4-style node for quantized summarization and embedding ops)
Autoscale policy: allow scale-up to 4 chat nodes during 2-hour morning peak (to cover QPS spikes), scale-down overnight; schedule nightly maintenance window for re-index to avoid autoscale thrash
KV cache sizing guidance: cache hot prefixes for 60% of active sessions; reserve ~16GB per chat node for KV cache depending on model seq len
Estimated monthly GPU hours (baseline): 2 nodes chat @24/7 = 2*720 = 1,440 h; plus bulk node 720 h. Convert to billing: evaluate reserved commit vs on-demand burst for cost tradeoff.
Estimated ARR impact: initial commit to Dedicated estimated at $75k-$150k ARR depending on committed hours and support tier; additional usage overage expected during peak re-index windows.
Action items: build detailed cost model (per-token + reserved GPU hours), confirm EU residency architecture, provide sample DPA and SOC2 artifacts.
